text:
emily (Docs): quick heads-up: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210 failing preview. Two things I spotted: the Console "prefetch" dashboard sample renders blank (404 on metric panel), and several observability snippets still show old keys: `cost_breakdown` and `trace_hook`. Can we triage briefly?

chris (Eng): digging in now. The panel JSON in docs/console/observability/prefetch.md references metric id `prefetch.lat_ms_v1` which was renamed in the telemetry cleanup. I'll swap to `prefetch.latency_ms`.

nina (Observability): I'll own the panel JSON change and run it through the dashboard schema validator. Also noticed the panel had `experimental: true` in a public sample — probably should remove that.

emily (Docs): good catch, remove it and change the panel title to "Prefetch (example)" so folks don't assume prod settings. Also the embedded playground path moved from `/playground/embed.js` to `/playground/embeds/embed.js` so the preview 404s.

leo (SDK): for the snippet renames I'll add a short compatibility shim in the snippet-runner. Plan: normalize keys so both `trace_hook` and `tracehook` are accepted during the rollout. Small helper: `def normalize(params): if 'trace_hook' in params and 'tracehook' not in params: params['tracehook']=params.pop('trace_hook')`. We'll keep shim for one release and add a TODO.

chris (Eng): pushed the metric id fix and removed the experimental flag. Still seeing the broken playground path; will update the embed reference.

ci-bot: PR 4210  sample-link-check FAILED: 2 broken links, 1 snippet-lint warning. https://ci.redwood-inference.net/ci/4210/logs

nina (Observability): local validator passed after metric change but flagged `prefetch.enabled` missing. Added boolean and reformatted JSON for readability. Pushed.

leo (SDK): updated snippet examples to use `tracehook` and left a one-line shim in the runner. Also grepped for `cost_breakdown` and updated two examples to `cost.annotation`. Added unit tests for both keys.

emily (Docs): tiny content nit: prefetch example lists `batch_size: 512` which contradicts our hosted guidance; changed to 64 and added comment "example only".

ci-bot: snippet-lint OK after fixes; sample-link-check OK; preview deploy queued.

chris (Eng): preview looks good: dashboard panel renders, playground embed loads. Link: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/branches/pr-4210

emily (Docs): perfect — please merge once CI finishes. I'll follow-up with a backfill PR adding redirects for the moved playground path and create a short migration note: docs/migrations/observability-params-2026.md describing the renames and the SDK shim with timeline.

leo (SDK): LGTM. Will remove shim after two releases and put deprecation note in CHANGELOG.

nina (Observability): thanks team. I'll also run a quick repo sweep for any lingering `cost_breakdown` or `trace_hook` mentions and open tiny fixes if found.

ci-bot: Preview deploy succeeded: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/branches/pr-4210

emily (Docs): merging now. Thanks all! :sparkles:
